# Install everything with: pip install -r requirements.txt
#
# This file is curated by hand -- one line per genuinely direct dependency,
# with comments explaining why each is needed. For the exact, complete,
# currently-working set of versions (direct + transitive), see
# requirements-lock.txt (auto-generated, regenerate it after installing
# anything new with `powershell -File sync_requirements_lock.ps1`).
#
# --- Extra package indexes -------------------------------------------------
# torch: PyPI's default wheel pulls in CUDA libraries even on a CPU-only box
# (multi-GB of unnecessary bloat); the official CPU-only index avoids that.
# llama-cpp-python: needs a local C++ toolchain to build from source, which
# most Windows boxes don't have -- this index carries prebuilt CPU wheels.
# Both are listed as plain `--extra-index-url` (not `--index-url`), so pip
# still falls back to PyPI for every other package in this file.
--extra-index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cpu
--extra-index-url https://abetlen.github.io/llama-cpp-python/whl/cpu
--prefer-binary
--only-binary=llama-cpp-python

# fury-sdk isn't published to PyPI; install from the sibling satellite repo.
# The base install needs only httpx/numpy/termcolor. [tts] additionally pulls
# in NeuTTS-nano's real deps (torch, llama-cpp-python, neucodec, onnxruntime,
# phonemizer) used by neu_tts.py for the actual neural voice -- without them,
# tts.py silently falls back to the robotic Pyttsx3/SAPI voice with no error,
# which is exactly the "rugged and metallic voice" regression this file
# previously shipped by omission. Also needs the espeak-ng system library
# (not pip-installable -- `winget install eSpeak-NG.eSpeak-NG` on Windows,
# `apt-get install espeak-ng` on Linux, `brew install espeak` on macOS).
-e ../../fury-main[tts]
torch>=2.10.0
llama-cpp-python>=0.3.0
neucodec>=0.0.5
phonemizer>=3.2.0
soundfile>=0.13.0

# Real semantic memory search (memory/graph.py's SentenceTransformerEmbedding)
# -- replaces the old hashed-bag-of-words placeholder, which could only ever
# match literal shared words, never actual meaning. all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (22M
# params) is small enough to run fast on CPU; torch is already required above.
sentence-transformers>=3.0.0

# Real cron-expression scheduling (cron_store.py's CronJob.cron_expression /
# is_due) -- replaces the old fixed-daily-hour/minute-only scheduler so jobs
# can run e.g. "every 15 minutes" or "9am weekdays", not just once a day.
croniter>=2.0.0

faster-whisper>=0.9.0
pyttsx3>=2.90
python-socketio>=5.9.0
python-dotenv>=1.0.0

numpy>=1.24.0
sounddevice>=0.4.6
fastapi>=0.104.0
uvicorn>=0.24.0
aiohttp>=3.9.0
# Imported directly (main_new.py's economic-calendar/webhook calls) -- was
# only ever present transitively (via anthropic/fury-sdk), which means a
# future version of either dropping it would silently break this file.
httpx>=0.28.0
psutil>=5.9.0
scipy>=1.11.0
scikit-learn>=1.3.0
nltk>=3.8.0

# Windows COM, for pythoncom (tts.py's Pyttsx3TTS -- SAPI5 is COM-based and
# needs CoInitialize() per thread). Only ever present transitively via
# pyttsx3's own Windows dependency; listed explicitly since tts.py imports it
# directly. No-op / not installable on non-Windows, hence the marker.
pywin32>=306; sys_platform == "win32"

# skill_loader.py parses SKILL.md YAML frontmatter directly -- only ever
# present transitively before (via faster-whisper's dependency chain).
pyyaml>=6.0

# PDF extraction for agent registry generation (Phase 1.9)

# Image handling for Telegram map snapshots (map_snapshot.py, imported
